title: Qualify current Balanced comparison at 40 GiB
question: Does the 8 GiB constrained Balanced ranking transfer to the same fixture shape at 40 GiB?
summary: One verified 40 GiB run per tool reproduces the 8 GiB order and near-identical input throughput. qsvlite 99.53 s, Chopper opt-in 190.55 s, and ordered materialized DuckDB adapter 314.36 s.

workloads: 40 GiB repeated plain CSV, eight exact consecutive parts, 1 GiB hard with swap disabled and one worker.

validation.summary: Separate small and full qualifications, complete ordered-byte and per-file quota verification, with Chopper manifest and cleanup checks.

limitations: One full qualification per tool, no large-size repeat variability.
WSL2/ext4. Input exceeds the cgroup and fits host RAM. Scope excludes native Windows.
DuckDB is the materialize-and-slice adapter. qsvlite has no separate engine setting or Chopper-equivalent publication contract.
exclusions: Small preflights. Generation, provenance hashing and output verification outside the timing scope.
reopen_when: Repeat at 40 GiB if a materially different candidate or workload makes the bound or scale transfer uncertain.
